question: How does the number of grids on which zero-shot GENCO beats the best learning-free interpolator change with the measured fraction of |V|?
config_names: f{pct}_s0 for pct in 10,20,...,90 (mask rule unchanged: k = max(1, round(frac*n)) buses, rng = default_rng([20261021+0, n, scenario_id]).permutation(n)[:k])

sets.locked15: the 15 locked grids and test scenarios of results/2026-10-21-genco-voltage-inference (grid list in that protocol.json; scenarios from ../2026-10-21-genco-state-inference/test_ids.json), 2,398 scenarios. Always run.
sets.pieces36: the 36 carved subgrids = 19 of results/2026-10-21-genco-voltage-inference-control (seen families) + 17 of results/2026-10-21-genco-voltage-inference-family-vs-size (unseen families), their own test_ids.json and datakit data (data/external/genco-carved-unseen/work/data). Run only if time allows after locked15; the 24 ladder-regenerated pieces of the generator-control study are NOT used. If pieces36 does not finish, the report says so and gives whatever grids completed.

identical_to_2026-10-21_study.methods: G = released GENCO pretraining checkpoint, zero-shot, candidate 7's DetMask, one pass; I1..I5 as defined in the 2026-10-21 protocol.json. For pieces36, I5 is the scalable variant ocommon.i5_gp (ML on at most 300 measured buses) exactly as those two studies used it.
identical_to_2026-10-21_study.scenarios: same test ids, same scenario count per grid
identical_to_2026-10-21_study.metric: per scenario mean over buses NOT in the measured set of ||V|_pred - |V|_label| (pu); per grid median over scenarios
identical_to_2026-10-21_study.win_rule: ratio = median_G / min_over_I1..I5(median_I), best interpolator re-selected inside each bootstrap resample; 2000 scenario resamples with replacement, percentile 95% interval; win iff ratio < 1 and upper end < 1. No threshold is applied.
identical_to_2026-10-21_study.bootstrap_seeding: numpy default_rng(7), ONE generator consumed sequentially exactly as verdict.py does (one test() call after another). Order: locked15 grids in protocol order for fraction 10%, then 20%, ... 90%; then pieces36 (control pieces in protocol order, then family-vs-size pieces) for each fraction in the same order. Because the stream position differs from the original run, intervals at 10/20/40% can differ slightly from the recorded ones; only the point ratios are reproduced exactly.
identical_to_2026-10-21_study.verdict_logic: the test() function body of verdict.py is copied verbatim into sweep_verdict.py (one config per cell, so no pooling); nothing is re-implemented.
identical_to_2026-10-21_study.note_on_recorded_hashes: the 2026-10-21 protocol.json's own code_sha256_16 entries match the first 16 hex chars of the vcommon.py / run_interp.py / run_genco_v.py hashes above; verdict.py was edited after that protocol was written (recorded hash f02de4a4..., current cae2e5e6...; the audit R1-F4 completeness check, see its header). The current file is the one copied.

existing_primary_verdict: The recorded 20% primary verdict (pooled over mask seeds 0,1,2: 8 of 15 grids, FAIL against the pre-set bar of 10) stands exactly as recorded. This sweep uses mask seed 0 only at every fraction, so its 20% cell is the recorded 'f20_seed0' analysis, not the pooled primary; the sweep does not replace, re-grade, or supplement the primary verdict. The bar of 10/15 is drawn in the figure only as a reference line.

control_reproduction.what: The new runner re-produces f10_s0, f20_s0, f40_s0 on locked15 (and on pieces36 if run). Compare every per-scenario vm_mae_unmeas to the stored value in 2026-10-21-genco-voltage-inference/{genco_v,interp}_per_scenario.jsonl (pieces: the control / family-vs-size per_grid files).
control_reproduction.tolerance_genco: max abs diff of per-scenario MAE <= 5e-5 pu (known float32 GPU noise)
control_reproduction.report: max abs diff per method and fraction, and the number of cells over tolerance. Also report whether the per-grid win flag at those three fractions matches the recorded f10 / f20_seed0 / f40 flags. A control failure is reported as such; the sweep numbers are then flagged, not silently kept.
